audit.whatIsWrong: Rows 0-2 read "Skill" on both layers while the whys under them say the levels are hers — "levels 1-2 hers with no way for you to answer". The page contradicts itself.
audit.why: Light Binding is 1175 range and Lucent Singularity 1100 against Ahri's 970 orb, with no gap-closer until 6. Lux genuinely owns levels 1-3; Ahri's 54.49% comes from level 6 onward.
audit.corrected: Lux / Lux / Lux / Skill / Ahri / Ahri / Ahri on both layers, proposed as one atomic group.

audit.why: Level 6 is the real hinge: Spirit Rush's three dashes both close the 200-unit range gap and leave the Lucent Singularity circle before detonation. First and second item extend it. Lux's Final Spark cooldown falls 60/50/40 but never gives her an escape.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page's central instruction — "minion-block it and her combo never starts" — is wrong as written, and spikes[1] calls Lucent Singularity a snare.
audit.why: Riot text, Q: "releases a sphere of light that binds and deals damage to up to two enemy units." It passes through the first target, so a single minion is not cover; you need two bodies in the line. Riot text, E: it slows and can be detonated — it does not root. The root is Light Binding.
audit.corrected: Two minions, not one; and E slows before it detonates so you walk out of the circle rather than tanking it.

audit.whatIsWrong: No cooldown numbers were on the page.
audit.why: Light Binding is a flat 10s at every rank, Lucent Singularity 10/9.5/9/8.5/8, Prismatic Barrier 12s to 10s, Final Spark 60/50/40 at 3340 range. The 10s Q is the window everything else is scheduled around.
audit.corrected: Written into cooldowns, dosFull[1].d, loading, report[5].t and report[9].t.

audit.whatIsWrong: Illumination was never mentioned, so the burst tell is invisible to the reader.
audit.why: Riot text: her damaging spells charge the target, and her next attack ignites it for bonus magic damage. The auto-attack wind-up — not the spell cast — is the moment her poke actually gets paid.
suspectNames flagged "Fox Fire" (should be Fox-Fire, per Riot's "three fox-fires") — corrected in spikes[1].text. "Spirit Rush's" was a false positive and is the correct name.
audit.corrected: Hyphenation fixed; no other name defects found.
